methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: To address this gap, the present study proposes an integrated energy assessment model named the Water-Energy Nexus Tool (WENT).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The model was applied to three case study plants, Molina de Segura, Ponte Metauro, and North Coast to evaluate the techno-economic feasibility of various low-carbon energy options.
